changes: Month normalized: 'taiṣa' (from Tiṣya = Puṣya) = Pauṣa; kept the written form in as_written

date.as_written: śailāgnighanage śāke taiṣe māse site dale || saptamyāṃ ravivare ca

notes: The chronogram 'śailāgnighanage' (catalogue: 'śailāgnidhanage') is corrupt or unusual. The clear parts are śaila = 7 and agni = 3. 'ghana/dhana' has no standard value. If the ending is read as naga = 7, read right to left the year would be 7-?-3-7, i.e. Śaka 17?37 → probably Śaka 1737 = c. 1815/16 CE. That year would fit the date of Pūrṇānanda (16th c.), but it cannot be confirmed, so ce_approx is left empty. The weekday (Sunday, Pauṣa śukla 7) has not been checked. 'likhaj jinaḥ' is odd: probably a scribal corruption (e.g. of janaḥ) or an epithet of the scribe, not a second person. The catalogue spells the scribe's name 'Vīśvānaṃda'; the colophon has viśvānaṃdo.
